articles.summary: Essex Property Trust, Inc. (NYSE:ESS) announced today that Angela L. Kleiman, President and CEO, will be participating in a roundtable presentation at the 2026 Bank of America Global Real Estate Conference on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 10:20 a.m. Eastern Time. To listen to the panel, please visit the webcast link under the latest events section of the Company’s Investors website at www.essex.com .
